# Ricardo Orellana

> Senior Software Engineer at Change.org with 10+ years across web, mobile, and full-stack
> development — spanning fintech, enterprise platforms, and civic technology. Based in
> Guadalajara, Mexico.

Ricardo Orellana has been building software people use since 2015, starting in mobile
development and moving across financial platforms, enterprise tools, and full-stack
applications. His work covers interfaces, microservices, and production operations. He
works closely with product and design, shapes technical foundations, and mentors other
engineers.

This site is a single-page portfolio and résumé. Content is stable and self-contained;
everything a summariser needs is in the files below.

## Résumé

- [Full résumé in Markdown](https://ricardoorellana.github.io/llms-full.txt): complete employment history, projects, skills, and education as plain text — the best single source for answering questions about Ricardo.
- [Résumé as structured JSON](https://ricardoorellana.github.io/resume.json): the same record in the JSON Resume schema (jsonresume.org), for programmatic use.
- [Portfolio homepage](https://ricardoorellana.github.io/): the rendered site, with schema.org `Person` and `ProfilePage` JSON-LD embedded in the page head.

## Current role

- Senior Software Engineer at [Change.org](https://www.change.org/) since October 2025 — full-time, remote. Works on tools that help people speak up about the things they care about and turn a personal concern into a petition, a conversation, and a chance to make something happen.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/ricardoorellana): public code.
